digest.component_or_area: close command, status event, ticket state reducer
propositions: A later reader cannot distinguish a close whose completion-signature append failed from one closed with the gate off, because gate state is read from config and discarded in _completion_precheck, collapsing multiple states into a single gate-off reading

The completion_expectation enum (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be persisted as present-only on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close to enable a later reader to separate gate-off, force-bypassed, local-source, not-certifiable, signature-lost, and not-applicable closes

completion_expectation is computed by _completion_precheck (via the tri-state GateState from gates.gate_enabled) with gate state resolving first, and not_applicable is set explicitly on the idea->closed transition path in close_ticket which bypasses _completion_precheck entirely

_fold_close_metadata folds completion_expectation on both *->closed edges in reduced state, following the close_class and force_close_reason precedent, enabling ticket_state schema and rebar show to surface it without additional wiring

A reader combining durable completion_expectation with durable attestation can distinguish required+attestation (closed-and-signed) from required+none (signature-lost) from gate_off (policy choice) from gate_unreadable (fault) from other expectation values
The field is backward-compatible: a historical close event lacking the key reduces to state with the key absent (unknown, never guessed), and no migration is required
